description: This file defines a static class 'GatewayInstruments' that contains static readonly counters for tracking gateway-related metrics such as sent messages, received messages, and load shedding, using the System.Diagnostics.Metrics API.

classes.name: GatewayInstruments
classes.description: A static class providing metric counters for gateway operations.

methods.name: GatewaySent
methods.description: Counter for tracking the number of messages sent through the gateway.

methods.name: GatewayReceived
methods.description: Counter for tracking the number of messages received through the gateway.

methods.name: GatewayLoadShedding
methods.description: Counter for tracking load shedding events at the gateway.
